rules.diagnosis: Very High Cohesion. The {package_name} package (and its elements) focuses exclusively on one ML stage and does not contain non-ML content. (CCP = {ccp_level})
rules.recommendation: Maintain and document the package as a reference model for future pipeline designs.

rules.diagnosis: High Cohesion. The {package_name} package covers multiple ML stages within one phase and does not contain non-ML content. (CCP = {ccp_level})
rules.recommendation: Maintain package structure if package size and conceptual clarity are well balanced; otherwise create sub-packages by stage.

rules.diagnosis: Medium Cohesion. The {package_name} package includes several phases, all related to the pipeline. (CCP = {ccp_level})
rules.recommendation: Group by ML phase. Consolidate modules or sub-packages of the same phase in one sub-package. Maintain hierarchy if already organized by phase. Consider creating sub-packages by stage if the number of modules for a stage is or grows too large.

rules.diagnosis: Medium Cohesion. The {package_name} package focuses on one ML stage but includes some non-ML elements. (CCP = {ccp_level})
rules.recommendation: Keep the ML stage isolated and move non-ML elements to another non-ML package, or reuse an existing sub-package if available.

rules.diagnosis: Low Cohesion. The {package_name} package belongs to a single ML phase but includes non-ML elements. (CCP = {ccp_level})
rules.recommendation: Separate non-ML content. Move non-ML content to another non-ML package. For large packages, consider creating sub-packages by stage if the number of modules for a stage is or grows too large.

rules.diagnosis: Very Low Cohesion. The {package_name} package includes several ML phases and non-ML content. (CCP = {ccp_level})
rules.recommendation: Separate non-ML content and reorganize. Move non-ML content to another non-ML package. Consider creating sub-packages by phase if the number of modules for a phase is or grows too large. Also consider creating sub-packages by stage if the number of modules for a stage is or grows too large.
